title: Short Paper Rubric
_note: The 'before' rubric — the one on the handout, deliberately weak. It is here so the Stress Test can load both sides of the comparison. Three things are missing ON PURPOSE and must not be 'fixed': there is no correctness criterion, so nothing asks whether a claim is true; no criterion carries an 'objective', so the rubric is not tied to the learning objectives; and no criterion carries a 'present_when' line, which is why Triage cannot read this rubric at all. 60 of the 100 points sit on organization, mechanics and length — things a reader can judge without knowing the subject.

criteria.name: Content
criteria.description: Discussion of the topic and understanding of data structures.

levels.4: 36–40 — Thorough, insightful discussion of the topic showing strong understanding of data structures.
levels.0: No discussion of the topic, or off-prompt.

criteria.name: Organization
criteria.description: Structure and flow of the paper.

levels.4: 27–30 — Clear introduction, body, and conclusion; flows well.
18–20 — Few or no errors in grammar, spelling, or punctuation.

criteria.name: Length & Formatting
criteria.description: Meets the stated length and formatting requirements.

levels.4: 9–10 — Meets the length requirement (1–2 pages); formatted correctly.
